tytul: Chicago-style giardiniera in oil: why there is no recipe here
wstep: There is no recipe here for Chicago-style giardiniera, mixed vegetables kept in oil with chili and vinegar.

ostrzezenia.tekst: It is hard to lower the pH of homemade vegetables in oil: vinegar mixes poorly with oil, so the vegetables themselves are not effectively acidified.
There are no validated processes for vegetables and herbs in oil made at home; in the USA, the rules for such products apply only to commercial processors.
Appearance, smell and taste cannot tell you whether vegetables in oil carry a botulism hazard.

akapity: The BfR names peppers and chili among the vegetables in oil with which a household cannot make sure that C. botulinum will not grow and form toxin.
JarAtlas has found no tested recipe for giardiniera in oil from a checked source.
